facts.raw_span: A 23-year-old man with end-stage renal disease due to IgA nephropathy
maintained on peritoneal dialysis (four exchanges daily; he had missed his last two)
was brought to a community hospital after a generalized tonic-clonic seizure
reported headache and blurred vision for several hours prior
blood pressure >182/107 mmHg
received labetalol 20 mg IV, lorazepam 1 mg IV, and haloperidol 1 mg IV before transfer
temperature 36.8 °C
blood pressure 200/100 mmHg
ECG demonstrated tall peaked T waves consistent with hyperkalemia
potassium 6.3 mmol/L
Noncontrast head CT revealed multiple cortical and subcortical hypodensities in the posterior parasagittal parietal lobes and the medial right occipital lobe
reported as suggestive of PRES
